## What was tried
This is item C17 of the coordinator issue #716 (next release: the features of issue 655 that the current plan does not cover), split out so it can be built and tracked on its own. Issue 655 was split into its 14 sections and one analyst per section classified every design feature against the unification spec and its decision record; this item is one of the features that were found missing. Nothing in this item is built yet. #716 stays the umbrella issue: its closing review holds the build order, the phases and the open owner decisions.

## Relevant files and links
- Parent issue: #716 (this item is a sub-issue of it). Sister issues of the split: watcher #717, TUI dashboard #718. Source design: #655.
- Current plan (local files, not pushed): `.dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/spec/SPEC.md` (stages S0 to S17, Appendix B after PR 700), `.dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/DECISIONS.md` (43 recorded decisions), `.dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/debates/*/VERDICT.md`, `.dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/spec/FOLLOW-UPS.md`.
- Per-section analysis with every row, status and evidence (local files, not pushed): `.dev/implement/reference-our-research-a-3463b8ef/sections/section-01.md` to `section-14.md`.
- Pull request 697 (closed unmerged revert of PR 682, replaced after PR 700 by PR 701) and the follow-up issues 698 and 699 come from the same review work.

## Done when
The item below is built, tested and checked against its own lines, or the owner records in chat that it is dropped. The text is copied unchanged from #716.

### C17. Default list of merge-safety files (655 section 7; rows S07-F20)
  - What to build: Define the default `merge_safety_files` list and say how it combines with the "absent means most restrictive" rule.
  - Done when: a config test shows that a repo with the key absent gets the stated default list, and an empty list is refused.
  - Research and debate results from our documents:
    - S07-F20: SPEC:48 "`master` is unprotected today (`protected: false`, no ruleset, no CODEOWNERS ...)"; FR-75 adds CODEOWNERS later (SPEC:339).
  - Watch out:
    - S07-F20: A default that names ruleset or CODEOWNERS files is moot in IronClaude until FR-75 lands.


## Pick-up note
- Read the review at the end of #716 first: it holds the build order, the three phases and the owner decisions that gate this item. The related-item ids above (C numbers) refer to the sibling sub-issues of #716.
- The plan files named above are local files, not pushed; read them from a checkout that has them, or ask the owner.

comments.body:
Merged into #797 (owner decision in chat, 2026-11-24, after a reviewed analysis of this sub-issue). Closing this one; continue in #797.

Why: the key has no consumer without the merge gate, both depend on the same R38 ruling, and the open choices (what "absent" means, how an empty list is recorded) are decisions of that gate. Three changes to carry into #797: the empty-list test must allow an owner-recorded empty list (QG3 OD-12); state whether "absent" means a named default list or "hold every merge"; name the default list explicitly (the FR-75 core paths plus `.github/workflows/` are the starting candidates).

title: [FEATURE] Coordinator C17: Default list of merge-safety files
